html:
Question 1
?

At each point P on a particular curve, the derivative y′(x) is proportional to the square of the shortest distance from P to the x-axis. What differential equation describes this curve?

a
y′=ky2
b
y′=kx2y2
c
y′=kxy
d
y′=kx2
e
y′=k(x2+y2)
